method: Native-color connected components are tracked frame-to-frame with constant-velocity prediction. Split, merge and nearby track breaks are conservatively joined into complete temporal groups. A deterministic duration-weighted selection removes whole groups, balanced over all six native colors. Binary alpha removal only. Retained RGBA pixels are byte-identical to source at the same frame and coordinates. No source-video reprocessing, new particle geometry or new trajectories.
limitations: Conservative temporal groups are inferred from raster pieces, not source engine particle IDs. A group may contain more than one touching same-color physical particle. The source raster does not expose an exact physical particle count. Full groups are removed throughout their observed lifetime, never partial opacity. Temporal source frame order is unchanged. Root timeline applies 80% playback speed separately.
